T01.gloss: sheep variety (sheep sign plus added element)
T01.reasoning: Circle-with-cross sheep sign with an added element; counted in lists alongside the other small-cattle signs.

T02.reasoning: Circle with two side blocks resembles EZEN; occurs in a recurring formula with administrative signs rather than as a counted good.

T03.reasoning: Stepped block shape like AB; often at tablet end after titles, as an institution name.

T04.reasoning: Animal-head shape; counted in cattle-style accounts next to cow and male/female signs.

T05.reasoning: Drawing shows two grain ears beside a rectangle; contexts are mostly name- or title-like, so low confidence.

T06.reasoning: Cross plus lozenge; last counted item in the standard flock list before the sheep total.

T07.reasoning: Strokes on a cord with a loop; counted in small numbers in mixed goods lists, paired with another product sign.

T08.reasoning: Very frequent at tablet end in the pair T30 T08 and after X1485, behaving like a title or bookkeeping term.

T09.reasoning: Appears in subscripts after grain totals (X1972 T09, X1983 T09); may be the ration sign.

T10.reasoning: Counted in small numbers in mixed goods lists; drawing looks like an implement or plant with a block end.

T11.reasoning: Rarely counted directly; usually ends sign groups like X1485 T11 and X0564 T11, as in personal names or titles.

T12.reasoning: House-frame with star inside matches AMA; occurs in person-like sign groups.

T13.reasoning: Three hill shapes = KUR; alternates line by line with X0611 as counted persons or animals by sex.

T14.reasoning: Follows many different sign groups as a closing qualifier in lists (… T14), parallel to T18, like a status or profession.

T15.reasoning: Long implement-like sign; counted singly in person-style lists and in name groups.

T16.reasoning: Sheep sign with lozenge; standard member of the flock list.

T17.reasoning: Heads cattle-style accounts followed by calf, female and male signs; rounded head shape.

T18.reasoning: Used as a closing qualifier after many sign groups in a list, parallel to T14.

T19.reasoning: Block with a handle, like an ingot or tool; counted in small numbers in goods lists.

T20.reasoning: Triangle (female) joined to a ladder box; recurs in subscripts such as X1310 T20 like a title.

T21.reasoning: Horned animal head; counted alone and with qualifiers in cattle lists.

T22.reasoning: Hatched strip on a base line; recurs in fixed group X1592 T22 in subscripts, like an institution or land term.

T23.reasoning: Clear bird drawing; note that in context it often sits in name-like groups.

T24.reasoning: Occasionally counted but mostly in person-like sign groups; drawing is abstract.

T25.reasoning: Often stands alone on a line as a heading or after X1178, like an official or bookkeeping term.

T26.reasoning: Recurs in the fixed group X0250 T26 attached to entries, like a title.

T28.reasoning: Long beam with triangular fitting like a plough; found in name or title groups, not directly counted.

T29.reasoning: Fringed box with crossed weave; counted directly in fairly large numbers.

T30.reasoning: Mostly in the closing pair T30 T08 and in subscripts, like a title.

T31.reasoning: Hatched banded shape; counted in large numbers inside sheep accounts and qualifying the sheep total sign.

T32.reasoning: Fish-shaped drawing with tail; counted in goods lists.

T33.reasoning: L-shaped object with strokes; counted in small numbers in mixed goods lists.

T34.reasoning: Usually final in multi-sign groups (X1203 T34, X1036 T34) as in personal names.

T35.reasoning: Hatched half-oval; closes a run of single-count entries (X T35) in food-style lists.

T36.reasoning: Circle-with-cross sheep sign with marks; first counted entry of the flock list.

T37.reasoning: Box within box; counted as a product after animal counts in herd accounts.

T38.reasoning: Horn-like pair of curves; counted in cattle accounts right after the cow sign.

T39.reasoning: Tapering strip with grid; mostly in name-like groups, sometimes counted.

T40.reasoning: Occurs in fixed groups (T40 X0622, T40 X0055, T20 T40) attached to entries, like names or titles.
